test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

When __you will be award__ for your achievements?
solution:
The correct answer is: **will you be awarded**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When forming questions using modal verbs like "**will**," the **subject and the modal verb need to be inverted**.
 
• The correct structure is "**modal verb + subject + main verb**."
 
• Therefore, "**will**" should come before "**you**" in the sentence.
 
• Additionally, the correct form of the verb "**award**" in this context is "**awarded**," the past participle form.
 
• The sentence discusses a future event (being awarded for achievements), and in English, we use the past participle form after modal verbs like "**will**" to indicate future actions or events.
 
• So, "**will you be awarded**" is the correct structure to express the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• The **corrected sentence** would be: "*When will you be awarded for your achievements?*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
